notes: Rule: A.1 item 13 'CALL statement (rules for program-name formation for a non-COBOL program). Calling non-COBOL programs is NOT supported: ProbeSiblingModule loads <name>.dll and requires a __CobolModule.Register() registrar, else 'not a COBOL.NET module' -> false -> EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND. Probe callfor.cob / callfor2.cob: CALL "Antlr4.Runtime.Standard" (a real foreign .NET dll in AppContext.BaseDirectory) and CALL identifier 'System.Runtime' both take ON EXCEPTION with EXCEPTION-STATUS = EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND. So the conditional obligation is NOT incurred, and CONFORMANCE.md §3 does say 'a non-COBOL element cannot be the TARGET of a CALL' (plus DOC-A.1-19 'no non-COBOL program can be declared'). PARTIAL rather than CONFORMS: there is no DOC-A.1-13 disposition row, so the register cannot see that the item is un-incurred (audit_annex_a1.py counts it in the 195), and even with a 'Not provided' row the derived 'a1-optional-not-provided' selector is keyed to requirement 'optional' and would not reach a CONDITIONALLY-REQUIRED item — no path to a closed verdict exists today (see findings: un-incurred-A.1-items-have-no-disposition-path). Worse, one resource failure IS detected and reported under the wrong name: ProbeSiblingModule finds <name>.dll WITH a __CobolModule registrar (the program is located) and then wraps LoadFromAssemblyPath + register.Invoke in a bare catch that returns false, so a located module that cannot be loaded/initialized (BadImageFormat, missing dependency, registrar/type-initializer throw) surfaces as EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND, whereas GR3c says 'If the program is located but the resources necessary to execute the program are not available, the EC-PROGRAM-RESOURCES exception condition is set to exist' (determined by reading; a failing-registrar dll was not built in this session). Sibling of kb/Work PB1422 (open; FUNCTION activation twin, A.1 item 89), whose body says 'The CALL twin (A.1 item 14, §14.9.4.4 GR3c) and INVOKE (A.1 item 102) should be swept the same way' but claims no CALL row — reported in findings.json as the CALL half of that mechanism.
